verdict.rationale: A first-party pricing page exists and lists included features such as round-robin and team scheduling, Stripe/PayPal payments, recordings and transcripts, a customizable booking page and calendar sync. Community users report per-user, per-month tier prices (e.g., $8 Essentials and $12 Professional, $16/$20 Teams yearly/monthly) and that round-robin is gated to the Teams tier, which indicates per-seat tiered pricing is published. However, the evidence pack contains no first-party price figures or feature-to-tier mapping, and the community numbers may be outdated. Missing for 10: first-party per-seat price figures for each tier, an explicit official mapping of features to tiers, and current independent corroboration of prices.
